## Checklist

- [ ] Folder name is lowercase-with-hyphens and matches the frontmatter `name`
- [ ] Description says what the skill does *and* when to use it
- [ ] Not a duplicate; if it overlaps another skill, the body says which to prefer
- [ ] No student names, UGA IDs, or grade data
- [ ] No API keys, tokens, passwords, or private URLs
- [ ] Ran `./scripts/validate-skills.sh` (or a maintainer should run it for me)
- [ ] Ran `./scripts/package-skills.sh` and committed the updated `.skill` (or a maintainer should)
